Yin Chen came on orders of the Silver Priests to take in him as his disciple. With his help, Qi Ling heads to the Grave of the Souls to seek his soul weapon, yet as he couldn’t sit still like how his lord instructed him, he enters the Grave of the Souls with Tianshu Youhua and Guishen Lianquan.

However, after a fortuitous encounter, this ordinary youngster became what people refer to as genius in a single leap. Possessing an aptitude for learning martial arts which would leave people in awe, regardless of whether it’s his clan’s Houtian Scripture of Five Phases or various Xiantian scriptures of legends. Regardless of whether it’s mental techniques or battle skills, he can comprehend them all in their entirety at a frightening speed. 8465.synopsis:
The main character Pei Jiao died in an accident. Due to the application of science in electromagnetic waves, it has resulted in an increase in electromagnetic waves on Earth. Every one who dies will become a soul. When the electromagnetic waves reach a threshold point, a hellish world and Earth will combine.

11793.synopsis:
“If I gave you the chance to become a human, would you want to?”
Back then, I simply smiled and said, “I don’t want to become a human. I want to continue being a bird, soaring freely in the skies. That’s perfect for me.”
As things changed with the passage of time, all of a sudden, I really wanted to become a human just once. Thus, I asked the god, “Can I still have another chance to become a human?”
However, the god shook his head, “You’ve already missed your opportunity. Furthermore, even if I gave you a chance now, you wouldn’t live past a single day.”

18961.synopsis:
To save Gao Zhun from the shackles of his invisible illness, Fang Chi overcomes obstacle after obstacle, inching closer and closer to his heart. But…
Everything you have done so far amounts to nothing more than a technique? What about…
Your feelings?
—–
Can the course of human feelings ever be truly understood?
In an attempt to diversify his career, Zhang Zhun agrees to co-star with award-winning actor, Chen Xin.
Their first task, by the director’s orders:
15 days of cohabitation in a couple’s room.15 days of watching raunchy movies in the same bed, in preparation for the filming of their first scene together.
Yet, things begin to go wrong as they get into bed for the camera.
No one on the set is safe from the passion of their performance.
No one is exempt from the heat of their desire.
Even the director cannot help but fume: Have I ever asked them to take things this far?
But… isn’t it our job to go deeper into the act?
—–
You are my secret sunshine.
Chen Xin risks everything in his possession as Zhang Zhun walks down the path of no return.
How should they define the bond between them?
Perhaps it should not be known as love, for love is too heavy and terrifying a word for them.
And yet…
There will never be another film like this! Your performance and the feelings you conveyed will never be surpassed! This is a masterpiece that belongs only to the two of you!
When their eyes meet – before the camera, according to the script – Zhang Zhun feels the tips of his fingers go numb.
Who is he?
Has he become Gao Zhun? Or is he still Zhang Zhun?
Who is this before him?
Is it Fang Chi? Or is it Chen Xin?
—–
When the filming comes to an end, the characters will recover, the actors’ passion will fade, and they will forget each other eventually as they return to their individual paths.
In the end, how should they make sense of it all?
Have they truly been hopelessly and deliriously in love?
Or have they simply lost themselves too deeply in the act?

Kitty Qi Xiaohan received an admissions notice. The lion who notified her gleefully smiled and told her that the employment rate after school was 100%, guaranteed.
With a heart of longing, Qi Xiaohan packed her luggage and moved to the school. When the schedules were issued, Qi Xiaohan was shocked to find out that even a cat was required to learn calculus and that they were not allowed to drop out!
What kind of modern-day education scam was this!
The kitty stretched her legs. Well, she was already here. On the first day, she put in all her effort to learn how to write her name.
After the initial exam was over, the fluffy classmates anxiously glanced at Qi Xiaohan, who had struggled with the cultural lessons. They wanted to console her, but were stunned when they found out she was unexpectedly ranked number one!
They glanced at the adorable little kitty, and then at the list.
Fluffy classmates: !

34065.synopsis:

Old Madam Qiao was reborn—seven days before her whole family was sent to the countryside.
Looking at her family, still safe and sound—her son and daughter-in-law alive, her two young grandchildren not yet dead, her children still in school… everyone she once longed to protect was right in front of her.
Everything could still be saved. She was no longer living like a walking corpse, all alone.
So, she took out the ancestral heirloom passed down through generations—only to discover that it was actually a space.
Whether it was gold bars and valuable jewelry from the Su family or the Qiao family, or property deeds, cotton clothes and quilts from home—she stuffed them all into the space.
She stockpiled supplies, hoarded medicine, and even secretly took all the gold, jewelry, and goods that those who once reported her family had hidden away.
Just in time for…
associated_names: 下放老太太重生：白米饭配红烧肉

114961.synopsis:
Seo Soohyun once worked as a protocol secretary for Geum Taemu, an obsessive and ruthless gangster ‘gong’ in a BL novel with an age-gap and dark themes.
Fed up with managing Taemu’s obsessive love affairs, Soohyun betrays him and escapes, finding himself transported to a new world.
Now working at Taeseung Corporation as an assistant manager in the Corporate Culture Team, Soohyun enjoys a peaceful, ordinary life.
However, one day, triggered by the simple word “cigarette,” he politely hands over his own cigarette to a stranger, reliving past trauma.
Cha Beomjun, a gay man forced to become the executive director in a heteros*xual modern romance novel, is compelled into engagement with a woman against his will.
Attempting to escape pressure from his fiancée and family, Beomjun flees and lands in Soohyun’s world. He quickly falls for Soohyun, captivated by his flawless manners and professionalism.
Seo Soohyun, who absolutely refuses to associate with any domineering chaebols again, and Cha Beomjun, who dreams of genuine love with a man he truly likes in a free world—who will win in the end?

115729.synopsis:
Mo Cinian transmigrated into a world that combined elements from multiple urban counterattack novels. 
He became a lunatic villain? 
Despite possessing endless wealth and top-tier connections as a major boss, he was ultimately killed by the plot? Left with a miserable end!
Unacceptable!
Thus… a shameless and ruthless schemer was born.
…
The Divine Doctor who came down from the mountains: “The city is full of tricks, I want to return to the countryside.”
The Detective King: “I must catch you!”
The King of Cowards who joined the chat group: “I flattered the group members for so long, thinking they were big shots, but they turned out to be frauds?”
The female lead with a built-in strategy system: “Is this man made of stone? I’ve been fawning over him until my mouth is numb, but the favorability points still hasn’t changed.”
associated_names: 反派：大小姐，你應該也想報仇吧

116241.synopsis:
“Su Qingyan, your sister and I are already divorced. Why are you still here?”
After divorcing his wife, whose net worth was in the tens of millions, Li Mo turned his attention to his sister-in-law, still lounging in the bedroom, and began shooing her out. The 19-year-old goddess Su Qingyan looked at Li Mo with sleepy eyes.
“Why get divorced so early? I’m not even fully awake yet. So what if you divorced my sister? Big deal. In a couple of days, I’ll find you another one.”
“Or if nothing works out, I’ll just marry you myself.”
Li Mo: “…”
That same day, an investment alert popped up on Li Mo’s phone: [“Invest in this abandoned construction project, it will become a school district property in ten days.”] 
“Find Ma Tengyun and invest in an instant messaging company. In three years, it will be worth trillions.”
Three years later, Li Mo had already acquired trillion-dollar enterprises like QQ and A-Li. Only then did Su Xiaoxiao realize—there was no man in the entire country more exceptional than Li Mo.
associated_names: 我跟你姐离婚了，你还不走？

118801.synopsis:
Jiang Ying, a rookie lawyer, unexpectedly runs into her old school crush Meng Jingshu at a dinner party.
Back then, Meng Jingshu had been lukewarm toward her and even ended up dating the girl Jiang Ying disliked the most during college.
Now, years later, fueled by frustration and a tinge of revenge — and right in front of her cheating ex — Jiang Ying leans in and kisses Meng Jingshu.
What she didn’t expect… was that he’d get attached afterward.
As misunderstandings from the past slowly unravel, a completely different version of the truth begins to surface.
“You know, I don’t regret that we didn’t get together earlier.
You weren’t good enough back then — so you didn’t deserve me.”
“And now?”
“Now? You’ve already got me.”
? Senior Year — Jiang Ying’s long-time crush starts dating her nemesis. Her “white moonlight” instantly turns into leftover rice.
? Years later — a heated kiss in front of her ex, a drunken one-night stand with her former crush, and boom — she’s slept with her white moonlight and cuckolded her old rival. Feels good.
? “Meng Jingshu,” Jiang Ying said, her voice quiet but firm. “If I don’t say anything, do you really lack all self-awareness?”
From across the restaurant table, she tilted her chin.
“Put the cigarette down.”
Very few people dared speak to him like that.
Meng Jingshu l**ked his teeth, but obeyed.
? “If I don’t get this man, the stars won’t turn, the constellations won’t move — the entire world’s off balance!”
? Love is day after day, nothing held back — skin against skin, heart to heart.

121873.synopsis:
Two years have passed since I sent my husband off to war.
The man I loved has returned, but as a traitor to our empire.
“Do I still look like a child to you?”
Our fates had been intertwined since childhood.
Growing up together, I believed ours was a love written in the stars.
“Win for me, Johan. And come back alive.”
It would be no exaggeration to say I raised him myself.
I could proudly say that no one loved him as I did.
Even if he was a political hostage, offered to my country under the pretense of tribute,
That was a matter between nations, not between us.
Yes, everything had been perfect… until now.
“Johan, you traitor—”
“You ought to commend how well I’ve learned from your lessons. Wasn’t it you who always told me ‘an eye for an eye’?”
Esha realized she was finally seeing Johan’s true colors.
“How does it feel to be defiled by your husband who trampled your own country?”
When you were younger, much younger than now, who were you really then?
How will our story ultimately end, Johan?
* This novel contains themes of coercion and morally dubious characters. Reader discretion is advised.

134161.synopsis:
It wasn’t until she was granted the title of Side Fujin that Gao Zhenru realized she had accidentally transmigrated into a novel—and not just any character, but the infamous villainess, Noble Consort Gao.
Her mission now? Continue being arrogant and willful—rely on the Prince’s favor to dominate the inner court and eventually the imperial harem. Cause endless complaints from concubines, earn the grudges of the Empress Dowager and Empress, make the Emperor utterly despise her—just to highlight the female lead’s gentle, kind nature. In the end, she would be scolded and left to languish in the palace, only to die tragically of illness during an epidemic.
Once the plot wraps up, she can retire from this small world.
After confirming that her death wouldn’t implicate the Gao family—in fact, they would rise even higher—Gao Zhenru happily agreed and began her role as the villainous supporting character with great enthusiasm.
Speaking of which… what exactly does a favored consort do?
Gao Zhenru thought it over and realized—just stick to the usual script. So she became the perfect model of a pampered consort: bold, arrogant, ostentatious, and extravagant… cough cough, though maybe not too wasteful.
And so, Gao Zhenru smoothly rose to become a Noble Consort. But when the time came for her supposed death, she suddenly realized something was wrong—why was she still alive and kicking?
And the female lead? How could such an important character simply disappear?
Depressed and anxious, Gao Zhenru grew visibly haggard—only to discover that the entire harem had taken a bizarre turn.
The Emperor: “Noble Consort looks haggard—it leaves me sleepless and unable to eat.”
The Empress Dowager, the Empress, and all the concubines: “Who dares bully our Noble Consort!?”
associated_names: 高贵妃能有什么坏心思？

145169.synopsis:
“Shocking! The Silver-White Sword Emperor’s true identity is the Demon King’s devoted little wife—a traitor to humanity!”
Hearing such a rumor, Gabrielle, the Silver-White Sword Emperor herself, was furious.
She absolutely had to clarify things.
“I am humanity’s strongest. The Demon King is nothing more than a defeated foe at my feet,” Gabrielle said, holy and imposing.
Yet unexpectedly, the Demon King also came to question her.
“Gabrielle, you are my…”
associated_names: 假装战败，取悦魔王小姐

149777.synopsis:
Emma, a professional assassin, infiltrates a mansion as a maid with the mission to eliminate Count Hincliffe, known as the ruthless northern killer.
Was it the sedative perfume she used that caused the suspicious man to succumb? The man, as cold as the north wind and relentless as the driving snow, begins to desire her.
“I’m curious. Why is it you, of all people, who stirs something within me?”
Initially, she intended to ease the tension between them. Then, it became a strategy to avoid being expelled from the estate. That’s how she rationalised her growing connection with him.
But why, even without the sedative perfume, do the days filled with mutual desire continue to increase? As the man transforms before her eyes, she finds herself beginning to waver.
“Just… put it in.”
“What did you say?”
“Just put it in. Just do it, please.”
Caught in a struggle between pleasure and guilt, will she be able to complete her mission successfully?

154641.synopsis:
“Grand Secretary Xue, Returns to the Past!”
In his dreams, he was Xue Dingyang. He had lived for over seventy years, revered as Grand Secretary Xue—the highest official in the land. Save for the Emperor, every living soul bowed beneath his feet. It was, by all appearances, a life where he possessed everything.
Or so it seemed. In truth, his final years were spent dying in regret. He had lost the woman he loved, and he had lost his only child. In the end, he had absolutely nothing left.
But when he awoke from that dream, He was back to being the small child of his past, “Xue Gouzi.”
His wife, Chu E, whom he had lost to his own regrets, was there. Even his family members, who blatantly favored the eldest son over him, remained exactly as they were.
“I cannot live the same life as that dream.”
He resolves to carve out a new path. After bestowing the name “Xue Dingyang” upon himself, the winds of change begin to sweep through his life.

162065.synopsis:
After failing an infinite mission, Ning Shixue transmigrates into a novel as a doomed cannon-fodder sickly beauty.
The original owner was infamous—obsessed, vicious, and destined to die miserably after being forced into a political marriage with the villain Xie Zhaozhou.
Wanting nothing but peace, Ning Shixue chooses to lie flat and survive as a fragile vase.
However, after joining a parenting reality show, his “useless” way of living unexpectedly captivates the audience. Children flock to him, fame comes overnight, and the villain’s child becomes fiercely possessive of his sickly dad.
Behind the scenes, the terrifying tycoon Xie Zhaozhou slowly realizes that his delicate spouse is far more dangerous—and far more precious—than anyone imagined.
A lighthearted story about accidental fame, found family, and a sickly beauty who only wanted to give up.
associated_names: 病美人摆烂后在娃综爆红了
病美人擺爛後在娃綜爆紅了

168721.synopsis:
During her tribulation, the grand master of metaphysics, Jiang Jingli, was ambushed and transmigrated into the body of a vicious female supporting character in the entertainment industry, four hundred years in the future.
The original host had been a complete disaster, a notorious s*umbag whose reputation in the industry had sunk to the point of being universally hated.
Yet even universal hate had its advantages. Jiang Jingli still commanded a significant amount of “black-red” traffic. She was invited to participate in a dating reality show as a dating observer.
Unlike the other celebrities, Jiang Jingli’s performance was nothing short of bizarre.
Other Observers: “Male Guest No. 1 is such a warm-hearted guy! He’s so good at providing emotional support.”
Jiang Jingli: “This man is surrounded by bad luck in love. It means he’s currently juggling multiple relationships and has a habitual tendency to cheat.”
Netizens: “Jiang Jingli must be jealous! This is pure slander!”
Other Observers: “No. 2 is a true industry elite! He’s a fashion designer who won a gold award at the French fashion industry.”
Jiang Jingli: “His midface is too long, and his eyes are too close together—the classic ‘thief’s eyes’ according to traditional physiognomy. Most of his fashion designs are plagiarized.”
Netizen: Jiang Jingli is spouting nonsense again! Can’t they kick her out of the entertainment industry?
Other Observers: Male Guest No. 3 is such a devoted son! Anyone who finds a husband like him is set for life!
Jiang Jingli: His filial piety is fake. He’s surrounded by malevolent energy, his face is gloomy, and he’s a complete domestic ab*ser.
Netizen: Jiang Jingli is spreading lies again! Ban her!
Yet, not long after the episode aired, everything Jiang Jingli predicted came true.
Netizens: No way! Is Jiang Jingli’s mouth blessed?
To pay off the original host’s debts, Jiang Jingli had to juggle a career in the entertainment industry with earning money through fortune-telling on a live-streaming platform.
Initially, everyone watched her streams to laugh at her. But over time, netizens gradually noticed something was off. Could Jiang Jingli actually have some ability?
Not only were members of the Taoist Association taking notes in her chat, but many police informants were also lurking, ready to make an arrest at any moment.
Netizens asked her: “Master Jiang, do ghosts and spirits truly exist in this world?”
The yellow talisman in Jiang Jingli’s hand turned to ashes, pinning a vengeful ghost to the doorframe. She flashed a sweet smile at the camera, “There are no such things as gods or ghosts here. Everyone should trust science!”
Alternative Blurb 2:
Recent misfortunes had plagued film queen Shen Jihe, from food poisoning during a set lunch to a constant stream of physical discomfort.
Medical examinations showed she was perfectly healthy, yet the days of mental fog persisted.
Jiang Jingli, her co-star, gave her a talisman. Shen Jihe initially planned to toss it, but decided to keep it out of curiosity.
To her surprise, her symptoms significantly improved. Wait, could Jiang Jingli actually have these abilities?
One-Sentence Summary: A metaphysics expert cleans up the entertainment industry!
Theme: Changing one’s destiny through effort and embracing a positive life.
associated_names: 玄学大佬穿为娱乐圈渣A

176913.synopsis:
When An Chen saw the rules hovering above the monsters’ heads, she thought deeply. It seemed she was a bit extraordinary. So the already reckless her became someone who loved exploiting loopholes. The monsters never expected how this woman could discover their weaknesses and pass through unscathed.
In the rule-filled world overrun by monsters, An Chen didn’t know how to navigate the rules to find the origin of the rule domain. She only knew that these monsters definitely knew something.
So, while all the monsters were enjoying humans’ fear of them, they suddenly saw a girl wielding a huge sword standing in front of them.
“Whatever you know, spit it out.”
Monster: “……”
You seem really arrogant.
Just as it was about to teach her a lesson, An Chen didn’t even swing her sword, and it was almost killed.
“If you don’t tell me, I’ll kill you.”

177425.synopsis:
The Transmigration Bureau assigned System 987 a newcomer. Rumor has it that this guy is a massive troublemaker—the perfect reinforcement for a world where the villainous factions are currently too weak.
He is set to debut as the Second Senior Brother of the Shenhua Sect, the strongest immortal sect, who has been wandering abroad. His mission: single-handedly turn the sect upside down and stir up utter chaos. Afterward, he is to join the demonic cult of the antagonist, Luo Wuxin. After causing a series of spectacular troubles, he will reach a glorious “wrap” (death scene) alongside the Big Bad.

186641.synopsis:
After winning a 30-million-dollar lottery, Lin Wan didn’t even have time to celebrate before she transmigrated into the cultivation novel she had been binge-reading all night.
To make matters worse, she became a cannon fodder supporting character destined to die within the first three chapters.
The System gave her a single directive: “Steal the female lead’s opportunities (fortunes) to return home. The more you steal, the faster you go back.”
Lin Wan thought about the girl in the original novel—the one who was cherished by the entire sect yet never grew arrogant or spoiled. She fell into a long silence.
“What did she ever do wrong? Why should I have the right to steal what belongs to her?”
System: “Then you might never be able to go back.”
Lin Wan: “Then I’ll just walk this path slowly. If I can’t run, I’ll walk.”
What she didn’t know was that this “slow” path would eventually lead her to a place where the entire cultivation world would remember her name.
associated_names: 穿書女配不搶女主機緣
